text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh! It's almost time for training. Let's 
turn off the TV and—

text_block_list.name: TV Show Host
text_block_list.text:
"So, with that said! Let's dive deep into 
the behind-the-scenes story of taking 1st 
place in the world tournament!"

text_block_list.name: TV Show Host
text_block_list.text:
"First, what do you think is the main 
cause?"

text_block_list.name: Pro Athlete
text_block_list.text:
"I kept visualizing myself achieving 
global domination. Aside from that..."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, eventually I'll be answering 
interviews just like this too, right?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"This, too, is an important mission to 
show everyone the road they should 
take..."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
............ ...Shall I watch for just a 
little longer?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It looks like it'll be good reference for 
back then too. I can just train extra to 
make up for being late!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl kept watching TV and 
ended up skipping her training.
